prompt: Talk trash to the Soviet space program. The Space Race is over. Rub it in.
response:
Hey, Moscow. Come here. Take a seat. 

Look up. See that big, glowing rock in the night sky? Take a real good look at it. Because there’s a Star-Spangled Banner planted in the dust up there, and your fingerprints are nowhere to be found. 

Look, we’ll give you some credit. You had a cute little head start. *Beep, beep, beep.* Sputnik was adorable. You put a beach ball in orbit, strapped a terrified stray dog to a rocket, and shot Yuri Gagarin up in a tin can. You guys were fantastic at the 100-meter dash. Congratulations. 

But the Space Race was a marathon, comrades. And when it came time for the main event, you didn't just lose; you tripped over your own shoelaces and fell face-first into the launchpad. 

We said we were going to the Moon by the end of the decade, and we actually did it. What did you do? You built the N1 rocket, which basically functioned as the world's most expensive, completely accidental fireworks display. Four launches, four catastrophic explosions. Your rockets couldn't even make it to space without turning into shrapnel, while Neil and Buzz were up there kicking moon rock, taking pictures, and leaving footprints that will outlast your entire political system. 

Oh, and don't give us that "we never actually meant to go to the Moon" nonsense. That is the biggest case of geopolitical sour grapes in human history. You wanted it. You tried. You choked. 

We didn't just beat you; we got bored and started disrespecting you. By Apollo 14, Alan Shepard was up there *playing golf*. We shipped a car 238,000 miles away just to do donuts in the Sea of Tranquility. We were out there joyriding while your space program was scrambling to hide Soviet engineering failures from your own citizens.

And what's the ultimate punchline? The Space Race is over, but so is the Soviet Union. We didn't just win the race; we outlasted your entire country. 

So every time you look up at the night sky, just remember who holds the undisputed, heavyweight, extraterrestrial championship of the world. 

Scoreboard, comrades. Scoreboard.
